summary: Added __hash__ and __eq__ methods to Todo class based on id field

implementation_details.approach: Added __hash__ method returning hash(self.id) and __eq__ method comparing by id field for id-based identity semantics
key_changes: Added __hash__ method to enable Todo objects in sets and as dict keys
Added __eq__ method to enable proper set deduplication by id

acceptance_criteria_met: hash(Todo(id=1, text='a')) does not raise TypeError
risks: None identified. The __eq__ change may affect existing code that compares Todos by all fields, but id-based identity is the expected behavior.
